title: Grateful Dead Live at Fillmore West on 1970-06-04
source: sbd > ?? > wav > audacity(snaps,crackles,pops) > wavmerge > cdwav > tlh(flaclevel8) > flac16

ai_review.summary: Sweet Jerry vocals and a standout Black Peter shine in this well‑played acoustic set captured on a clear mono audience recording.
ai_review.review: Reviewers rave about the acoustic portion of the show, calling it an outstanding performance with Jerry’s voice sounding especially sweet and Black Peter highlighted as a high point. The mono tape source is praised for its exceptional clarity despite being missing the opening song and having a brief cut in “Swing Low”.

ai_rating.rationale: Four detailed reviews consistently praise the musical performance and audio quality, yielding an overall strong rating with only one moderate‑star comment.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Mono tape likely from a Taper's Section source; clear and sweet sound but missing the first song and contains a cut in “Swing Low”. Overall clarity is described as exceptional.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Acoustic set flows smoothly, with strong playing throughout; reviewers note the entire segment feels nicely executed and enjoyable.

band_member_comments.Jerry: His voice is described as sweet, lovely, and a highlight of the performance.
